# IRocketRules.Push property

How hard a rocket's explosion throws a runner, replacing its velocity: 500 by default, up at that speed (or down, for a runner in the air below the explosion), and sideways at that speed less the distance to the explosion. 0 only stuns.

public float Push { get; set; }
